name: Agent editor Evals tab renders its own empty-cases state
description: Opens the seeded Test Quality Reviewer and switches to its Evals tab. Guards reachability the same way 11-agent-context-tab.flow.json does: the tab button and the ?tab= whitelist on /agents/[id]/page.tsx are two separate places (client/insights.md 2026-08-17), and a build where they disagree would still change the URL while silently falling back to Config. So the URL assertion alone is not enough — the last step asserts on copy (evalsTab.emptyCases) that only the Evals tab renders. The hermetic seed has no eval cases for this agent, so this doubles as the empty-state check.

steps.label: tab state is in the URL
the Evals tab's own empty-cases copy is visible — no other tab renders this text
